[[File:Fetid zombie icon.png|left]]
'''Fetid zombies''' are [[monster]]s involved in the [[Dead and Buried]] quest. The player need to defeat ten of them in the quest to collect [[map piece]]s.

Their combat stats scale to the player's stats.

==Drops==
{{DropsTableHead}}
{{DropsLine|name=Map piece|quantity=1|rarity=Always|raritynotes={{DropNote|Only while there are map pieces left to collect.}}}}
